summary.en-US: Bring back the classic YouTube look: the old video page layout, logos, icons and likes bar, plus options to hide Shorts and other clutter.

description.en-US:
ClassicYT brings the look and feel of the classic YouTube layout back to the modern YouTube site.

What it can do:
• smaller video player and the old video page layout, with views, likes bar and channel info arranged like before
• classic logos (2005 to 2017), favicons and the old filled icons
• old likes/dislikes icons, green/red likes bar and precise like counts (works together with Return YouTube Dislike)
• limit comments and related videos to 20 with a "Show more" button instead of infinite scrolling
• the autoplay toggle back in the related videos column
• hide Shorts, end screens, the AI summary, surveys, hashtags, chapters and many other elements
• choose how many video thumbnails are shown per row
• export and import your settings
• settings in English and Bahasa Indonesia

Most settings take effect after reloading the page.

ClassicYT is a fork of YouTube Redux by omnidevZero (MIT license), maintained for current versions of YouTube and Firefox. It does not collect or send any data.

Source code: https://github.com/andrizan/YouTubeRedux
